preconditions.description: The length of the permutations is between 1 and 2000.
Both permutations p and s have length n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in s)
preconditions.description: All elements in p and s are integers between 1 and n.
Both p and s are permutations of numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the minimum number of coins required to transform p into s.
The second line of the output is the number of operations needed to get the solution.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in return_value[2:])
postconditions.description: Each operation consists of two distinct indices i and j between 1 and n.
Applying the sequence of swap operations transforms p into s.
